caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a lidded container, such as a shaker or spice container, positioned upright in the center of the composition. The container has a bulbous lower body that curves inward toward a short stem and a round base. The upper portion is a tall, dome-shaped lid with a small finial at the top and is perforated with a symmetrical pattern of holes. The drawing is rendered primarily in shades of gray, using pencil or graphite, to create shading and highlights that give the object a metallic appearance. The background consists of a roughly rectangular, light brown wash that frames the object, created with uneven, brush-like strokes. The rest of the paper is a light cream color, and there is handwritten text in the lower right corner, partially overlapping the brown background area.
title: Silver Shaker
